3153 * kicca 'mud, dirt'. 2. * kacca-². 3. * khacca-. [Cf. Drav. words quoted s.v. * gicc - and further groups
s.vv. kiṭṭa - and kaccara -¹, and * cikka -²] 1. Phal. kičal 'mud', číčal 'clay'; Ku. kīc 'mud, dirt',
B. kicā , kicaṛ , Mth. kīc , kī˜c ; H. kicpic f. 'mud', kicṛā m.
'gummy secretion of eyes', kicṛāhā 'muddy'; G. kīc , kīcaṛ m. 'mud', M. kicaḍ m. 2. Paš. kačaṭā́ 'piece, bit'; Mth. kāc , kāc-kīc 'mud,
filth'. 3. Dm. khača 'dirty, bad'; Gaw. khaċ , khas 'bad';
Kal. khāčä 'bad, dirty (?)'; Sv. khaco 'dirty, bad'; Phal. khāču 'bad' (?), khāčo 'a lie', khā́čulo 'dirty, bad'. kiñculaka- 'worm' see * kēñcuka -. KIṬ 'fear': * kiṭyatē . Addenda: * kicca- . 1. S.kcch. kicaḍ m. 'mud', H. Brj. kīc , kīcaṛ m., Ko. kiċkiċu 'muddy'. — H. kicṛā 'secretion from
eye' cf. Ko. piċċaḍa id. (< piccaṭa -, see * piccikā -)
S. M. Katre. — S.kcch. phonet. k+caṛ AKŚ xviii.
